title: stale_at_check.sh refuses a thread named by its shown id: build the canon path through Intent, with a test fixture
objective: `intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/stale_at_check.sh`, a report-only gate tool, builds a thread's canon path by hand, so it refuses a thread that a person names by its shown id (item 5 of ST1c2db93's close sweep, reader C). The gate runs it with no id. hv parked the fix here (hv decision 106, 2026-11-25): resolve the id through Intent, and add the test fixture the fix needs.
